content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the district court of utena the case involved two parties referred to as the applicant and the defendant the applicant requested the division of movable property specifically two cars an audi a4 and a vw golw the defendant did not object to this request so the court allocated the vw golw to the applicant and the audi a4 to the defendant the applicant also sought the annulment of the marriage establishment of residence for a minor child maintenance and order of costs the court decided to establish residence for the child with the applicant and ordered the defendant to pay maintenance the court upheld the applicants action and ordered the defendant to pay the applicants legal costs and stamp duty the court also annulled the marriage and ordered the division of matrimonial property the applicant dk was ordered to pay the defendant gk €806 for legal fees and stamp duty while the defendant was entitled to recover €54 from the state budget for stamp duty
